# restate_kafka_cluster (Data Source)

A Kafka cluster configuration, looked up by name.

**Sensitive property values are redacted by the API**, and this data source has no configured values to fall back on, so `properties` reports the API's placeholders for them rather than real credentials. Do not feed them to anything expecting a working password.

`subscription_ids` is what makes a safe teardown order expressible: a cluster with subscriptions attached cannot be deleted without orphaning them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Sensitive property values come back redacted, and this data source has no configured values to
# reconcile them against, so `properties` reports the API's placeholders rather than real
# credentials. Do not feed them to anything expecting a working password.

data "restate_kafka_cluster" "orders" {
  name = "orders-cluster"
}

# A cluster with subscriptions attached cannot be deleted without orphaning them, so this is what
# makes a safe teardown order expressible.
output "attached_subscriptions" {
  value = data.restate_kafka_cluster.orders.subscription_ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Cluster name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the cluster configuration was created.
- `properties` (Map of String, Sensitive) librdkafka properties, with sensitive values redacted by the API.
- `subscription_ids` (List of String) IDs of the subscriptions that reference this cluster.
